notes: Sourced from GatesAir's official datasheet for the Intraplex IP Link 100n (1RU rack-mount model), the current flagship of the "IP Link 100" family — GatesAir also sells an IP Link 100c (portable half-rack chassis) and IP Link 100e (modular plug-in card for Flexiva transmitters), which have different physical I/O than what's listed here; if the user meant one of those, ports would differ. Rear-panel photo and connector table cross-checked and consistent. Ethernet grade (eth-1g) confirmed explicitly (10/100/1000 Base-T). USB-A port speed not stated, so grade omitted. The 26-pin D-sub "EXTERNAL I/O" (contact closures) and the 1PPS BNC have no exact id in the allowed connector list / were not visibly labeled in the rear-panel photo (only inferred from the spec table text) — flagged individually above. An optional GPS receiver plug-in kit adds an SMA antenna connector; omitted here since it's a non-standard add-on and SMA isn't in the allowed connector list.

ports.name: DC power (screw terminal)
ports.note: Backup DC power, two-pin screw terminal; +12VDC 2A external or internal -48VDC

ports.name: 10MHz
ports.note: External 10MHz reference clock input for GPS/timing sync

ports.name: 1PPS
ports.note: External 1 pulse-per-second GPS timing input; datasheet lists this alongside the 10MHz BNC though only 10MHz is visible labeled in the rear-panel photo

ports.name: SERIAL
ports.note: RS-232 aux data, D-sub 9-pin male, programmable 2400-19200 bps

ports.name: EXTERNAL I/O
ports.note: Contact closures (4 in / 4 out, opto-isolated), physically a D-sub 26-pin female connector — no exact match in the connector list, rs232 chosen as the closest D-sub-family id; this is NOT an RS-232 serial port

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Rear-panel USB Type A host port for playlist backup/audio playout; speed not stated in datasheet

ports.name: AES IN 1
ports.note: XLR3 connector carrying digital AES/EBU (AES3) audio

ports.name: AES OUT 1
ports.note: XLR3 connector carrying digital AES/EBU (AES3) audio
